children: Stephens & Co. maintained their Overweight rating on Occidental Petroleum's stock with a price target of $80.00.
The price target implies an upside of 28.2% from the Oct 16 close of $62.38.
Key takeaways from the analyst note

: Occidental Petroleum has demonstrated impressive production performance, with average net production reaching 1.4 million barrels of oil equivalent per day in 2025, supported by robust results from their operations in the Permian and Rockies regions. This growth positions the company favorably for future revenue generation.

: The company is projected to significantly reduce its net debt to $5.2 billion by the end of 2026, enhancing its financial stability. With a strong liquidity position of $8.3 billion, including cash and credit capacity, Occidental is well-equipped to navigate market fluctuations and invest in future growth opportunities.
